annotations.title: Change publication status, vacancy lifecycle or embedding

description:
[Interviews] Change an interview's or position's publication `status` (draft, active, archived...), or a position's vacancy `lifecycle` (open, applications_closed, on_hold, filled, cancelled, closed) with an optional reason_id and note, or its embed key (is_embedded). Closing a position e-mails the candidates whose applications are still open.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

is_embedded.description: Controls iframe embedding of the interview on an external page. A signed coaching embed (name, email, signature) signs the visitor in as a learner of that portal, and the session is charged to the merchant's interview credits on completion, not to the learner's coaching credits; it cannot start while the merchant has none.

lifecycle.description: Multi-stage positions only (422 for an interview): the vacancy lifecycle to move to (needs the position lifecycle switch of the company, else 403). Allowed moves: draft to open or cancelled; open, applications_closed and on_hold to each other and to filled, cancelled or closed; filled, cancelled and closed back to open (else 422). Moving an open position to filled, cancelled or closed archives it: when the company has the position-closed notice switched on, every candidate with an open application then gets the position-closed e-mail (at once or on the company's e-mail schedule).
lifecycle.x-mcp-description: Multi-stage positions only: the vacancy lifecycle to move to. draft goes to open or cancelled; open, applications_closed and on_hold go to each other or to filled, cancelled or closed; those three go back to open. on_hold and cancelled need reason_id. filled, cancelled and closed archive the position and can e-mail every candidate with an open application (the position-closed notice, when switched on).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

note.description: With lifecycle: a note kept in the position's status history (at most 1000 characters).

position_id.description: Interview definition id (interview_def_set.id) or position id (position_def_set.id) whose state should change.

reason_id.description: With lifecycle: a position status reason of the company (merchant_taxonomy.id, type position_status_reason) that applies to the target lifecycle.

status.description: New publication status (type_interview_status): draft, active, archived, deleted, preparing, completed. Refused (422) for the AI interview step of a position (visibility sub_item), which follows its position. Activating a position whose required custom fields are empty is refused with 422 (name custom_fields). Archiving an active position sends the position-closed e-mail to candidates with open applications when the company has that notice switched on.
status.x-mcp-description: New publication status. Refused (422) for the AI interview step of a position, which follows its position, and for activating a position whose required custom fields are empty. Archiving an active position can e-mail its candidates with open applications (the position-closed notice, when switched on). Prefer `archived` to `deleted`: a deleted interview can no longer be read or updated.

name: set_interview_state
